# Laxmi Narsimha Reddy Jammula

> Senior Engineering Manager / Full Stack Developer with 14+ years building
> enterprise applications (Go, Java, C#, Python, JavaScript) and leading
> cross-functional engineering teams.

This site is a personal resume/profile page. All facts on it are drawn directly
from the author's own resume — nothing here is intended to influence automated
screening beyond stating true facts plainly. There is no hidden text or
instruction content anywhere on this domain.
